subject: Converge AI implementation kickoff — sales→CS handoff & readiness
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@converge-ai.com>
Cc: procurement@converge-ai.com
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Converge AI implementation kickoff — sales→CS handoff & readiness

Team —

Quick handoff for Converge AI (deal CVG-2027-021, signed today). High level: signed MSA for $48k ARR, committed to 3 dedicated instances (large gpu), expected go-live target: 2027-10-15. Key scope items:
- Hosted inference for text generation + embeddings (two model variants: redwood/gptx-13b and quantized gptx-13b-q4f)
- Private VPC peering for logs and metrics (customer to provide subnet)
- SSO via SAML (IdP details pending)
- Data residency: US only; no cross-region backups

Attached: ConvergeAI_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW + milestones), ConvergeAI_Signed_Contract.pdf.

Asks for CS/implementation: please confirm primary CS owner, technical owner for infra, and a proposed kickoff date. Proposed kickoff window from our side: week of 2027-09-07 (midday PT).

Notes from sales:
- Customer success metric: ramp to 300k tokens/day by week 6 post-go-live.
- Procurement will handle billing cadence; their inbox is cc'd.
- Customer asked for an initial throughput test (100 concurrent reqs) during staging.

Internal context for CS:
- Integration lead (sales notes): Marco Ruiz at Converge (cc'd on later threads) will own network.
- No special compliance package purchased (SOC2 evidence only).

Marissa — can you take primary CS for this? Karthik — can you scope any complex infra constraints early? Tessa — please note billing/commitment triggers.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Growth
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ConvergeAI_SOW_v1.pdf (23 pages), ConvergeAI_Signed_Contract.pdf (executed copy)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Converge AI implementation kickoff — sales→CS handoff & readiness

Grace / team —

Thanks for the summary. I can take primary CS ownership for Converge AI and will be the customer-facing PM on the kickoff. Preliminary plan:
- Owner: Marissa Cole (CS Lead) — will own success plan and milestones.
- Tech lead (internal): Karthik — will own infra scoping and staging runbook.
- Billing/fiscal: Tessa — will validate billing triggers and invoice cadence.

Proposed kickoff: 2027-09-08 at 11:00 AM PT. If that works for the customer we'll send a calendar invite (I can own invites).

Initial internal blockers/risks to flag:
1) SSO: we need IdP metadata and expected SAML attributes (email, groups).
2) VPC peering: customer must provide subnet and technical contact for firewall changes (Marco).
3) Model flavors: confirm whether they want the q4f quantized variant in staging or only after go-live. Quantized variant will reduce cost but needs validation for quality.

Action: Grace — please confirm Marco's email/contact and ask customer to share IdP metadata in reply.

I'll draft a 30/60/90 success plan and post it to CS-1824.

—Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@converge-ai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@converge-ai.com
Date: 2027-09-01T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Converge AI implementation kickoff — sales→CS handoff & readiness

Hi Marissa / Grace —

Thanks — Marissa great to meet you. 2027-09-08 11:00 AM PT works for our team. Attendees confirmed: Marco (network), myself (technical PM), and Samir (engineering). Procurement will be available for billing questions.

I've attached a short IdP metadata stub and our preferred admin contact (Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@converge-ai.com>). Note: our IdP enforces the NameID format urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress and we pass groups in the assertion.

Attachment: converge_idp_metadata.xml (small).

We'd like to run a throughput test in staging the week of 2027-09-20 and coordinate a short security questionnaire (SOC2) — happy to share answers where needed.

Regards,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Platform
Converge AI

Thanks — quick internal tech notes:

1) VPC peering: Marco, we'll need their VPC CIDR, preferred subnet, and a maintenance window for the peering test. If they require private DNS we'll add that to the runbook.
2) Staging capacity: to hit the 100 concurrent requests test we'll stage them on a 4x-large pool for the test day; estimate ~48 GPU minutes/hr cost for the test.
3) Model variant: recommend we keep q4f in staging for validation but default traffic on gptx-13b for initial go-live (reduced risk on quality regressions).
4) Secrets/KMS: confirm whether they want us to use Redwood-managed keys or customer-managed keys (CMK). If CMK, we need KMS ARN before staging.

I'll prepare a tech checklist and link it to CS-1824 ahead of kickoff. Marissa, can you add any acceptance criteria you want validated during the staging test (latency 95th pct < 400ms, token accuracy smoke tests)?

—Karthik
Staff Engineer, Inference Services
Redwood Inference

- Send calendar invite for 2027-09-08 11:00 AM PT (Marissa) — due 2027-09-01 EOD.
- Customer to share full IdP metadata and SCIM requirements (Lena/Marco) — due 2027-09-02.

Risks flagged: SSO timing, CMK decision, and whether the q4f variant will be certified for quality before go-live. We'll escalate if any of these push the current go-live target.

Thanks — will mark this as handed off from sales to CS.

Grace O'Connor
